summary: The legal array has at most 100 entries, so the complete source domain is too tightly bounded for a reliable runtime-scaling verdict between linear counting and slower frequency recomputation.

workload_bound.source_constraint: nums has length from 1 through 100 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation performs one Counter update per array entry, then one constant-time prime-set lookup for each of at most 101 distinct values. Every legal execution therefore has at most 100 count updates and 101 lookups.

Authored cases cover length one, all-unique values, prime and composite counts, multiple distinct composite counts, value bounds 0 and 100, the largest legal prime frequency 97, and the maximum length and frequency 100.
